verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party machine identity, service account, or per-agent credential feature in Supabase Auth. RLS-scoped tokens, custom access token hooks, self-signed JWTs, JWT expiry settings and refresh-token revocation are developer building blocks for constructing agent identities, not a shipped least-privilege agent-identity capability with instant revocation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give each agent its own least-privilege machine identity with narrowly scoped permissions and instant revocation, instead of sharing a human's credentials
